Selected public tutorials with R code and worked examples for clinical research. These RPubs resources cover study design and applied analysis. The linked tutorials are primarily in Japanese.

[Browse all RPubs resources](https://rpubs.com/Ryohei){.btn .btn-primary}

## Causal inference & survival analysis

### [Difference-in-differences (DiD) and event study](https://rpubs.com/Ryohei/1434914)

A brief introduction to DiD and event study concepts for readers new to these methods.

### [Time varying covariate in Cox regression](https://rpubs.com/Ryohei/822874)

A tutorial on Cox regression with covariates that change over time, with a focus on immortal time bias and time-dependent analysis.

## Clinical prediction models

### [Sample size calculation for clinical prediction model development](https://rpubs.com/Ryohei/930254)

An introduction to sample size calculations using the R package `pmsampsize`, for researchers planning prediction model development.

### [Prediction model development and evaluation after multiple imputation](https://rpubs.com/Ryohei/930276)

Missing-data imputation, model development, performance assessment, and validation with `mice` and `psfmi`, including how to pool results across imputed datasets.

## Latent class analysis

### [Latent class analysis: from missing-data imputation to reporting results](https://rpubs.com/Ryohei/1188880)

Code examples using demonstration data, covering MissForest imputation, latent class analysis, fit indices, and the VLMR test.

---

These learning notes reflect the time at which they were written or updated. Check your R and package versions when using the code.
